# Chapter 3 - State variables {#sec-state}

Shared simulation state lives in `aee_core_*` mission variables. Any mod or
mission script can read them. The variables below are grouped by subsystem.

## Biome

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `biome` | The current biome code |
| `biomeName` | The current biome name |
| `moduleBiomeOverride` | The biome override from the EDEN module |

## Temperature

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentTemperature` | The current air temperature |
| `surfaceTemperature` | The current surface temperature |
| `currentWaterTemperature` | The current water temperature |
| `moduleTempOffset` | The temperature offset from the EDEN module |
| `thermalCrossoverActive` | Whether thermal crossover is active |
| `crossoverTimer` | The thermal crossover timer |

## Wind

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentWind` | The current wind vector |
| `currentWindDir` | The current wind direction |
| `currentGusts` | The current gust strength |
| `moduleWindMultiplier` | The wind multiplier from the EDEN module |

## Pressure

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentPressure` | The current pressure |
| `currentPressureTrend` | The current pressure trend |
| `pressureReading1` | The first pressure reading |
| `pressureReading2` | The second pressure reading |

## Humidity and precipitation

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentHumidity` | The current humidity |
| `overcast` | The current overcast |
| `rainAccum` | The accumulated rain |
| `currentFreezingRain` | The current freezing rain |
| `currentBlowingSnow` | The current blowing snow |
| `currentSandstorm` | The current sandstorm |
| `currentDustDevil` | The current dust devil |

## Air density

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentAirDensity` | The current air density |

## Cloud and fog

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `cloudCeiling_m` | The cloud ceiling in metres |
| `currentFogDensity` | The current fog density |

## Hydrology

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentWaterLevel` | The current water level |
| `currentTideOffset_m` | The current tide offset in metres |
| `currentTideDescription` | The current tide description |
| `waveHeight_m` | The wave height in metres |

## Sea state

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `seaStateBeaufort` | The sea state on the Beaufort scale |
| `seaStateCurrent` | The current sea state |
| `seaStateDescription` | The sea state description |

## Turbulence

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentTurbulence` | The current turbulence |

## Radiation

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `currentUVIndex` | The current UV index |

## Forecast

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|

## Environmental

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|

| `currentFireRisk` | The current fire risk |
| `currentFloodRisk` | The current flood risk |
| `currentIcingSeverity` | The current icing severity |
| `currentLightningRisk` | The current lightning risk |
